question: Does the explicit ZF energy carrier supply an actual dynamics on the Krein space and its compact-operator C*-algebra, rather than only a static functional calculus?
answer: Yes, for the free reduced-mode system. The coordinate formula (U_t x)_i=exp(-it energy(i))x_i defines a strongly continuous Hilbert-unitary and J-unitary group in ZF, preserves Dom(D), and has the already-certified diagonal D as generator. Conjugation alpha_t(A)=U_t A U_t^* defines a point-norm continuous one-parameter *-automorphism group on K(l2(I))^~. On a matrix unit E_ij it is multiplication by exp(-it(energy(i)-energy(j))); the finite-rank derivation is -i[D,A]. No eigenvector selection, abstract spectral theorem, Stone theorem, or Choice principle is needed because the basis, energy function, phases, and finite-rank core are explicit. This is free compact-cylinder dynamics only, not nonlinear Bateman-Turok evolution, causal propagation, interacting dynamics, or a physical state-selection theorem.

coordinate_unitary_group.hilbert_unitarity: Every coordinate multiplier has modulus one, so U_t^dagger_0 U_t=1.
coordinate_unitary_group.krein_unitarity: U_t commutes with the diagonal J, hence U_t^dagger_0 J U_t=J.
strong_continuity_proof: For x in l2(I) and epsilon>0, choose a finite energy-coordinate head whose squared tail norm is below epsilon; the explicitly convergent coordinate sum supplies such a head without a choice function.
The tail contribution to ||(U_t-1)x|| is bounded by twice the tail norm because both multipliers have modulus one.
The head is finite, so ordinary continuity of finitely many functions exp(-it energy(i)) makes its contribution tend to zero.
coordinate_unitary_group.generator: The strong derivative on Dom(D) is -iD, with D the imported self-adjoint diagonal energy operator.
coordinate_unitary_group.domain_invariance: U_t preserves Dom(D) because multiplication by unit phases leaves sum energy(i)^2 |x_i|^2 unchanged.
theorem_avoidance: Stone's theorem as an existence theorem

cstar_dynamics.algebra: A=K(H_1)^~, the unitization of compact operators on the explicit mode carrier
automorphism_properties: alpha_t preserves K(H_1) and fixes the adjoined identity
cstar_dynamics.point_norm_continuity_proof: Given compact K and epsilon>0, choose finite-rank F with ||K-F||<epsilon. Isometry gives ||alpha_t(K)-K||<=2epsilon+||alpha_t(F)-F||, and the last term tends to zero because F has finitely many matrix-unit coordinates.
cstar_dynamics.fixed_point_fragment: Energy-block-diagonal compact operators have Laurent degree zero and are fixed.
cstar_dynamics.nontriviality_witness: A matrix unit from an energy-3 coordinate to an energy-2 coordinate has degree -1 and acquires a nonconstant phase.

fock_lift.generator: dGamma(D), the imported total-occupation energy operator
fock_lift.properties: The same coordinate proof gives a strongly continuous unitary and Gamma_s(J)-unitary group preserving every particle-number sector.
fock_lift.boundary: No interaction, scattering limit, thermodynamic state, or implementability theorem for a different representation follows.

continuity_and_foundations.sufficient_base: ZF with the already imported real/complex scalar and l2 completion
continuity_and_foundations.exact_numeric_boundary: The proof uses exact coordinate identities and an analytic epsilon-tail argument. The checker represents phases by formal Laurent degrees and performs no floating-point sampling of t.
continuity_and_foundations.physical_input: The cylinder energy grading supplies the coordinate energy function. It does not logically imply ZF or a choice axiom.

finite_exact_witness.arithmetic: exact integers and formal Laurent exponents only

cube_promotions.basis: The explicit energy phases give a strongly continuous J-unitary free-mode group.
Conjugation gives a point-norm continuous automorphism group on the unitized compact algebra.
The coordinate unitary/J-unitary construction and continuity proof require no Choice.
A genuine free C*-dynamics now replaces the previous static-functional-calculus-only status.

nodes.statement: I and l2(I) are explicit in ZF.
D is explicit diagonal self-adjoint energy on its maximal domain.
J is explicit, bounded, and commutes with D.
A finite-head/tail proof establishes strong continuity.
Only free reduced-mode dynamics is established.

The energy label n is the free compact-cylinder time-translation generator on the reduced-mode carrier.
K(H_1) denotes the norm closure of the explicitly finite-rank coordinate operators.
